# Seer Documentation - AI Navigation Guide
# https://docs.seersearch.com/llms.txt
#
# Seer helps teams evaluate and monitor retrieval quality for AI systems.
# It logs retrieval traces, computes quality metrics, supports change/accuracy
# testing workflows, and powers alerts and production monitoring.

# Machine-readable indexes
Sitemap: https://docs.seersearch.com/sitemap.xml
llms-full: https://docs.seersearch.com/llms-full.txt

# Product information
- Main website: https://seersearch.com
- Book a demo: https://seersearch.com/book-demo
- Contact: ben@seersearch.com

# Key concepts
- Retrieval logging: capture query, retrieved chunks, rank/order, and metadata.
- Evaluation metrics: precision@k, recall@k, nDCG, hit rate, and related ranking signals.
- Change testing: compare retrieval quality between model/retriever/index variants.
- Production monitoring: watch quality, latency, and cost with configurable alerts.

# Quick example
# SDKs are available in private beta. You can always test ingestion with cURL:
#
# curl -X POST "https://api.seersearch.com/v1/log" \
#   -H "Authorization: Bearer $SEER_API_KEY" \
#   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
#   -d '{"query":"What is RAG?","retrieved":[{"text":"RAG combines retrieval and generation."}]}'

# URL structure
# All documentation pages are at the root level (e.g., /quickstart, /overview).
# The docs homepage is /introduction (root / redirects there).

# Key documentation pages

## Getting started
- /introduction            - Documentation homepage
- /overview                - Product overview and core concepts
- /quickstart              - 5-minute setup with Python, TypeScript, and cURL
- /logging                 - Logging APIs and SDK patterns

## Core platform
- /metrics                 - Retrieval metrics and interpretation
- /production-monitoring   - Monitoring dashboards and operational guidance
- /alerts                  - Alert policies, defaults, and webhook payloads
- /logs                    - Traces/records views for debugging and analysis

## Testing and evaluation
- /accuracy-testing        - Ground-truth evaluations and scoring workflows
- /change-testing          - A/B testing retrieval system changes
- /multi-hop-retrieval     - Multi-hop retrieval evaluation guidance

## Schemas and SDKs
- /context-and-event-schema - Event format, limits, and API schema details
- /sdk-python              - Python SDK reference (private beta)
- /sdk-typescript          - TypeScript SDK reference (private beta)
- /mcp-integration         - MCP integration status and roadmap
